system.description:
A dark grey or black metal ringed by orbiting golden motes, so hard only the greatest artificers can shape it; anything made of it is completely indestructible. It follows the general magical-material rules (counts as Best, one hearthstone slot, magical damage).

Melee weapons gain +8 Pen; ranged weapons get a bonus equal to their RoF when attacking with a Full Auto burst; special ammunition gains +12 Pen; armour halves the Pen of weapons that hit you, except Darksteel ones. A bionic arm cannot be destroyed by critical damage (effects that would kill or destroy it only sever it) and its unarmed or natural attacks gain +8 Pen; bionic legs are protected the same way and give two raises to move others or resist being moved; a bionic heart ignores critical damage to the Gizzards and doubles their Resilience.
system.effectText: Indestructible. Melee +8 Pen; ranged +RoF to hit on bursts; ammo +12 Pen; armour halves incoming Pen; bionics resist crits.
